description: Price candles (OHLC and swap volume) for any Uniswap v3 pool on Base, computed from on-chain Swap logs: open, high, low, close per 1-60 minute bucket over the last 100-5000 blocks, with token addresses and decimals (pool=0x..., interval=5, blocks=2000; default WETH/USDC). For trading and market-making agents that need a chart without a data-vendor key. Pay per call $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.

blocks.description: how many recent blocks, 100-5000, default 2000 (about 2 s each)

pool.description: Uniswap v3 pool address on Base, 0x..., default WETH/USDC

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment (X-PAYMENT header value); omit on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements
